statement: A census of every fixed bound constant in src/ (const <NAME>(_TIMEOUT_MS|_DEADLINE_MS|_BUDGET_MS|BOUND_MS) = <number>, 29 at 6d58fdba1) records for each its owner module, what it waits for, its class (liveness, work, mixed, not a wait, test-only), the outcome when it is spent, whether a re-drive repeats discarded work, and its history; a systemic analysis names the repair shape each work and mixed bound belongs to under R12 (load slows the system, never breaks it); today's three measurements of work measured by a fixed bound are recorded. No source or test bound is changed.

constraints.statement: Evidence and design only: no src change, no test-bound change (owner rule). The WASI startup repair belongs to quest wasi-component-startup-budget and is cited, not duplicated.
Static analysis at the sealed base; every classification cites its site; outcomes not traced are said to be not traced; independent review before landing.
